C0053.title: Onion Group's KOC Model Collapses: Recruitment-Driven Pyramid Scheme Leads to Business Implosion
C0053.summary: Onion Group relied on a KOC (Key Opinion Consumer) commission model for viral growth, structured into three tiers: 'Progressive Store Owner,' 'Honorary Store Owner,' and 'Banquet Service Provider,' each requiring a franchise fee.
